found_at: https://www.goextrovert.com/ (<link rel=icon type=image/svg+xml href=/favicon/favicon.svg>; the site's logo for dark backgrounds, /logo_light.svg, draws the same cream disc with a dark e)
edits: deleted the favicon's @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) block from its <style>, keeping its default colours (disc #232205, e #F9F0DE)
cropped the viewBox to the mark (pad 0.02)
#232205 ↔ #F9F0DE swapped (disc cream, e dark olive): exactly the favicon's own prefers-color-scheme: dark colours, and what the site's dark-background logo /logo_light.svg shows
notes: The brand's mark is not grey: it is a very dark olive (#232205) and a cream (#F9F0DE); both colours are kept. The current file was the favicon itself, shipped for both themes with its @media block: an follows the OS colour scheme, not NoClick's theme, so on a dark OS the light theme drew a cream disc that vanishes on white, and on a light OS the dark theme drew a near-invisible olive disc. The two files fix each theme to the brand's own colours for it.
